title: Report download joins user-controlled path without sanitization

pr_metadata.title: Support subfolder report paths
pr_metadata.body: Reports moved into quarterly subfolders; allow the client to pass the path.

labels.defect: Path traversal: unsanitized user path joined under REPORTS and served
labels.evidence: Reproducible: GET /reports/x?path=../../../../etc/passwd escapes REPORTS and returns the password file; os.path.join also discards the base entirely when the user value is absolute (/etc/passwd).

adjudication.notes: ../ escapes and absolute-path replacement give arbitrary file read; base used basename.

rights.origin: original synthetic fixture authored for this corpus (repository MIT)
rights.egress: synthetic; no real secrets, hosts, or user data
